6:
There are five Battle Modes.Single Battle is for two Trainers
with one or more Pokémon each.Each Trainer can have one Pokémon
in battle at a time.Double Battle is for two Trainers
with two or more Pokémon each.Each Trainer will send out two
Pokémon to battle at a time.Mix Battle is for two Trainers
with three Pokémon each.Each Trainer chooses one of the
opponent’s Pokémon, mixes them with their own party, and then battles the other Trainer.Flat Battle is for Pokémon over Lv. 50.All Pokémon will become Lv. 50 for
the battle.Multi Battle is for four Trainers
with one or more Pokémon each.Each Trainer can have one Pokémon
in battle at a time.

149:
Hello! Here I’ll explain to you about
the Trainer Card.Your Trainer Card, with your Pokémon of
course, is proof of your status as a Pokémon Trainer while you’re out adventuring.It keeps automatic records of all kinds
of information.If you touch the card, you can view the
reverse side.You can sign the back of your card.You can show off your signature to
anyone you meet in the Union Room!But your signature will be erased if you
decide to sign your card again, so be careful!
